utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: From what I’ve heard, Mara, the big asks are still extension cords, spare screwdrivers, and folding tables since Milo and Priya already have the toolbox, fasteners, tubes, and patch kits covered.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That helps a lot—since I’m already on tool sorting, let’s focus asks on extension cords, spare screwdrivers, and folding tables, while keeping the porch steps and the center roof as the top priorities.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Mara—I’ll keep spreading the word that extension cords, spare screwdrivers, and folding tables are the main asks, with the porch steps and center roof first on the list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I think it’s by the community center parking lot, but I’d check the flyer so we don’t guess wrong.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, that sounds right—while they’re still pulling things together, the main gaps I’m hearing are tools and tables, and we still need someone to lead the roof work.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, that tracks—bring the flyer when you swing by, and we’ll confirm the spot and time quick.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Once Oren sends that list this afternoon, I’ll coordinate with Leo while I’m out so the tool and table pickups stay on track.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Before I rely on that, can you confirm Oren’s actually locked the spot and who’s committed to using the side street so the driveway stays clear?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard that confirmed yet—what I know is Oren said he’d send the list this afternoon, and once that’s in I can check on the parking piece while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help once school drop-off’s done and before 2, so if the repair drive needs sorting or phone calls in that window, I’m in.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: That works—can you handle sorting and a few phone calls before 2 if Cleo gets the list over in time?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, that works for me—if Cleo gets the list over after drop-off, I can handle sorting and make those calls before 2.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m finalizing the item list now, and once Opal confirms the spot I’ll send it to Leo and loop in anyone needed for sorting or calls.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, but I really just need to know whether people are actually sticking to the side street so the driveway stays clear before I plan on coming by.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m waiting on Opal to confirm the spot, but the plan is the side street so the driveway stays clear, and I’ll let you know as soon as that’s locked in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, Vik—I’m still waiting on Opal to confirm the spot, and then I’ll check the side street, make sure the driveway stays clear, and send Ira the list this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it—I’ll tell folks we’re doing the repair drive soon, and once Noah sends me the final plan and you’ve got the spot confirmed, I’ll pass along the details.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik—that helps, and I’ll send you the details once Opal locks the spot and I’ve checked the driveway bit.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll be a little late, but when I get there I can sort the tools and pitch in for a while.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s fine, Dane—once Opal confirms the exact spot, we’ll set the drop-off plan and then you can sort the tools when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good—I’ll swing by late and start on the tools once I get there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll be there around 9 with my ladder and toolbox, and if the roof still needs a lead, I’m glad to help there too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s great—I only heard second-hand that they’re still short on extension cords, spare screwdrivers, and maybe a couple folding tables.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring a couple spare screwdrivers too, but I don’t have extension cords or folding tables on hand.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Noah, before I place Gus, can you confirm who’s leading the center’s roof and whether that one-story gutter job at 9 is actually on?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, I’m still getting the repair drive details straight, so I can’t confirm the roof lead or that 9 o’clock gutter job just yet.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks for telling me—I'll hold off on placing Gus until those details are confirmed. Please let me know as soon as you’ve got the roof lead and the 9 o’clock gutter job pinned down.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Quinn, I’m keeping the list, and we still need the fence patched and the tools sorted for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—let’s keep extension cords, spare screwdrivers, and a folding table at the top of the list, and I’ll keep pulling folks in for this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it, Quinn—I’ll keep those supplies flagged, and we still need hands for patching the fence and sorting the tools this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Cleo’s still tracking it, but last I heard the fence patch and tool sorting were the jobs that still needed help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rey—I’m still confirming the exact spot, but the flyer points to the community center parking lot, so I’ll lock that down before we send anyone over.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Okay, that helps—once you confirm the spot, I’ll plan on the fence patch after gutters and check with Cleo about the tool list.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll be there early to get things started, and even a short bit from you helps a lot—if you’ve got an extension cord or a spare screwdriver, that’d make the morning easier.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That helps a lot, Uli—thank you. I can bring an extension cord, and just so we’re aligned, the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center and we’re still collecting tools in the meantime.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa—that’ll help a lot. I’ll be there early on Sunday at the community center and do what I can.
